findings.claim: The static observation 'locks/counts work and inserts an assignment' says more than the code shows. In claim(), the WIP count query (rait-case-command.service.ts ~2055-2067) has no FOR UPDATE. Serialization comes from the earlier FOR UPDATE on the pool row, the pool_member row and the existing-assignment probe, not from locking the counted work. Also, the WIP check runs after candidate selection, so with an empty queue and a reached WIP the result is QUEUE_EMPTY rather than ASSIGNMENT_WIP_LIMIT.
findings.fix: Change the wording to say the member, pool and active-assignment rows are locked and active work is counted without a lock. Note that the WIP check runs after candidate selection. Keep this as a static observation for later concurrency and ordering proof.
